stage: Fresh tri-state exact-size route observations and durable no-send opportunity scheduling
runtime_requirement: Keep bot/API/UI/training/research stopped. No operator signing, wallet/provider calls, real orders, active model fit/promotion or policy activation is authorized by this source stage.
findings: The actual run_bot route probe coerced every QuoteResult.ok false to has_route false, including local budget refusal, auth/quota/network errors and malformed responses. This is a verified current source defect, not proof of its contribution to the historical no-buy run.
That probe always made an additional Price API request even though its price_available field had no consumer, using shared gateway capacity unnecessarily.

Required unknown routes/prices used ordinary retry/cooldown paths instead of the existing bounded temporary-observation queue. Unknown liquidity could be recorded as a no_liq policy rejection before the common preparation guard.

The actual execution tail treated known pre-send quote/order/price rejection as an execution failure, opened an execution shadow and removed the candidate. The existing buy journal already proved these original attempts had not dispatched.

Paper route consumption checked public amounts but did not independently recheck the complete raw payload and original receipt age. Its generic NO_ROUTE return also obscured checked impact/configuration refusals.
implemented: Add one route-observation contract used by actual scanner, paper entry and legacy buyer precheck. Positive observations recheck complete original raw identity, exact raw amount, slippage, route/impact and public fields. Check original timezone-aware receipt age at most10 seconds without refreshing it through structural revalidation. A received HTTP quote is not provider market-asof, execution or finality evidence.

Only a strict duplicate-free bounded64KiB HTTP400 errorCode envelope from the actual canonical official quote request may establish a negative route observation. Accept only NO_ROUTES_FOUND, COULD_NOT_FIND_ANY_ROUTE, TOKEN_NOT_TRADABLE and ROUTE_PLAN_DOES_NOT_CONSUME_ALL_THE_AMOUNT. Store only the sanitized enum and exact request/status/receipt binding. HTTP200 error envelopes, mixed success/error, arbitrary text, custom sources, other statuses and stale/mismatched records remain unknown. This conservative acceptance policy is not a claim that the public documentation specifies every HTTP envelope.
Remove the unused extra Price API call from the actual route probe. Keep required fresh price admission separate. Never replace frozen decision price/features with a later admission quote or price.

Defer required unknown routes before bootstrap revalidation, and again at the final execution guard. Defer unknown required price or liquidity through the same whole-decision observation queue. These unknown observations do not become false negative route features, policy rejects or financial outcomes. Optional routes remain optional, but unknown evidence never grants route permission.

Use existing entry_observation queue behavior: five-second wait, no retry-budget decrement or permanent blacklist for these temporary waits, absolute maximum age and capacity limits unchanged. No new unbounded loop or hot-queue priority bypass is introduced.

Before requeueing a NO_ROUTE/NO_JUP_PRICE/NO_JUP_ROUTE/NO_JUP_ORDER result, require the actual durable original buy journal to be no_fill, with matching caller address/size/paper identity, exact zero quantity/rejection and no dispatch/fill evidence. Re-read and validate its persisted original record. Conflicting/unreadable proof quarantines that address in the current store; sent or uncertain outcomes remain in original recovery without another submission.

Record proved no-send preparation as wait/deferred, clear the pending vector and re-evaluate the whole decision. Do not call negative strategy execution feedback, open an execution shadow, create SQL positions or fabricate a closed outcome for that attempt.

Keep checked impact, invalid configuration/amount and capital refusals blocked. Give paper high-impact and invalid-impact-limit results their actual HIGH_IMPACT/INVALID_IMPACT_LIMIT codes instead of disguising them as temporary route absence. Exact0.1 SOL sizing, original managed execution proofs and uncapped runner behavior remain unchanged.

limits: This stage fixes software observation/admission feedback and scheduling, not the historical run's complete quantified causal attribution or profitability. No fresh market/provider access, prospective bot run or actual financial result is observed.

Ten seconds limits local receipt age only, not provider market age. A valid quote is not executable current depth, a managed order, a filled transaction or financial finality. A Metis routing rejection applies only to this request/size/time and cannot establish absence on all managed routers or venues.

Current-process quarantine on unreadable/conflicting terminal evidence does not certify full restart/current-wallet reconciliation. Resolved historic no-fill/feature/model records are not retroactively regenerated or financially labeled by this change.

The temporary queue remains bounded. Historical blacklist entries, provider quotas/latency, capital constraints and independently checked safety gates may still prevent purchases; no gate is lowered to create trades.

Full unsigned router/Token2022 semantics, equivalent other-provider proofs, fresh original current-wallet/restart reconciliation, finalized financial labels and separately authorized prospective closed full-strategy evidence remain incomplete. Extreme runner targets beyond500/1000/5000 percent are uncapped learning/exit objectives, not demonstrated or guaranteed gains.
